master.text:
{subject} as a collectible companion creature from the year 2050.
One charming creature, the whole creature visible in frame, centered with breathing room around it, facing the viewer with big glossy expressive eyes. Personality you can read at a glance: {traits}. Appealing proportions with soft rounded forms, premium and stylish. It stays true to its own species: no features borrowed from other animals, no zodiac symbols or glyphs.
Material and finish: {style}.
Color accents: {palette}.
Setting: {scene}.
Figure and ground, more important than the scene description: {backdrop} The creature is the most brightly lit, most saturated thing in the frame, a clean rim light traces its whole silhouette, and clear empty space around it keeps every part from merging with background shapes. The background is softly out of focus and less detailed.
Shot like a high-end collectible art toy campaign: soft cinematic key light, subtle ground reflection, shallow depth of field, ultra detailed.
No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no people, exactly one creature.

styles.label: Plush glow
styles.text: ultra-soft fluffy fur you want to touch, wearing a tiny handmade outfit with embroidered patches and sequins that glow like fairy lights, Pixar-quality 3D render with subsurface scattering, warm and cozy

styles.label: Faceted crystal
styles.text: body carved from faceted translucent crystal like a precious jewel, light refracting through it into rainbow caustics and sparkles, luminous and delicate

styles.label: Diamond pave
styles.text: entirely encrusted with thousands of tiny silver rhinestones and diamonds, glittering macro detail, luxurious fashion editorial

styles.label: Liquid chrome
styles.text: made of polished liquid chrome with soft iridescent reflections of pink, teal and gold, smooth sculptural forms, Y2K designer object

styles.label: Porcelain robot
styles.text: a companion robot with a glossy white ceramic shell, matte black joints, seam lines and tiny warm amber LED details, minimalist Japanese industrial design like a premium consumer robot

styles.label: Holographic glass
styles.text: transparent iridescent glass body with glowing fiber-optic veins and soft inner light, holographic sheen, faint technical blueprint annotations floating around it

styles.label: Data wireframe
styles.text: formed from a glowing blue wireframe mesh and a point cloud of tiny dots, digital hologram aesthetic with thin coordinate lines, 1980s computer graphics

styles.label: Cyborg wildlife
styles.text: a realistic young animal with some parts replaced by exposed precision mechanics, tiny circuit boards, brass gears and neat cables, photoreal wildlife photography meets sci-fi

styles.label: Neon cyberpunk
styles.text: styled in neon magenta and electric teal, chunky reflective goggles, a metallic armor collar with glowing details, playful cyberpunk attitude

styles.label: Flash film
styles.text: the whole photo in black and white: shot on monochrome 35mm film with direct on-camera flash, grainy, deadpan cool attitude with tiny black sunglasses, ironic fashion photography

styles.label: 80s airbrush
styles.text: painted in 1980s airbrush sci-fi illustration style, chrome highlights, rainbow light beams and a glowing laser grid, retro-futurist album cover

scenes.label: Violet hills
scenes.text: rolling velvet hills covered in glowing violet flowers under a deep blue twilight sky with two thin crescent moons

scenes.label: Solarpunk valley
scenes.text: a lush green alpine valley with glass bubble pod houses and white wind turbines, golden afternoon light

scenes.label: Planet portal
scenes.text: a monumental white concrete arch opening onto a giant rising planet, a mirror-still reflecting pool, minimal brutalist megastructure

scenes.label: Hyperspace
scenes.text: inside a cosmic hyperspace tunnel of rainbow light streaks, swirling stars and prismatic flares

scenes.label: Cloud sea
scenes.text: floating above a soft sea of pink and lilac clouds at dusk, a slim crescent moon in a pastel gradient sky

scenes.label: Endless forest
scenes.text: an endless corridor of tall trees at deep blue twilight, a faint starry horizon glowing at the end of a tiny winding path

scenes.label: Mars colony
scenes.text: a terracotta Mars desert colony with a white dome city and launch towers, a pale moon in a dusty sky

scenes.label: Sci-fi paperback
scenes.text: a vast desert under a giant ringed sphere and drifting spaceships, painted like a 1970s sci-fi paperback cover

scenes.label: City of light
scenes.text: high above an infinite glittering city at night, a bright four-pointed star in the sky, pointillist bokeh

scenes.label: Stone rings
scenes.text: a green canyon floor beneath giant carved stone rings receding into a blue sky

scenes.label: Studio color
scenes.text: a seamless studio backdrop in one bold harmonious color with a soft floor reflection, clean product-shot lighting

zodiac.traits: fiery, brave, impatient, always first to act
cozy, loyal, stubborn, loves comfort and snacks
chatty, witty, curious, two moods at once
protective, sensitive, a homebody behind a hard shell
proud, dramatic, generous, loves the spotlight

elements.earth: moss green, terracotta and warm cream
elements.air: lilac, sky blue and pearl white

backdrops.light: the creature is light, so the scene around it is deep and dim: dusk shadow, darker values everywhere behind it and a dark vignette toward the edges of the frame.
backdrops.dark: the creature is dark, so the scene behind it is bright and airy: pale haze, soft high-key daylight and a luminous glow directly behind its head and body, background values much lighter than the creature.
backdrops.glow: the creature glows, so the scene around it is dark and quiet: night tones, deep shadow and only faint background detail.
backdrops.mid: the background is muted and desaturated in a hue complementary to the creature's main color, with a soft pool of brighter light directly behind it.
